subject: mathematics
content: Let the foot of perpendicular from the point $$\mathrm{A}(4,3,1)$$ on the plane $$\mathrm{P}: x-y+2 z+3=0$$ be N. If B$$(5, \alpha, \beta), \alpha, \beta \in \mathbb{Z}$$ is a point on plane P such that the area of the triangle ABN is $$3 \sqrt{2}$$, then $$\alpha^{2}+\beta^{2}+\alpha \beta$$ is equal to ___________.
